response.justification: Bogdan has extensive experience as a fullstack developer with strong TypeScript, React, and Node.js skills, matching the core requirements. His work on energy/geospatial platforms and AI-agent infrastructure demonstrates relevant domain adaptability, though his PostgreSQL experience is limited to MongoDB. High on-site presence may be feasible given his Berlin-based roles.
strengths: Deep fullstack expertise across TypeScript, Node.js, and React with demonstrated scalability
Proficiency in cloud-native tooling (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker) and modern architectures
Strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD, clean architecture) and mentorship experience
concerns: Limited direct PostgreSQL experience (focused on MongoDB), though SQL familiarity exists
Overqualified for junior/mid-level role (10+ years experience), may seek faster growth
German proficiency is basic, which could impact on-site collaboration in Berlin
